# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Thank you for taking security seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability in this repository, please report it responsibly.

### How to Report

**Please DO NOT open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Instead, please report security issues by:
1. Email: Contact the repository maintainer with details of the vulnerability
2. GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting: Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) feature

### What to Include

When reporting a vulnerability, please provide:
- A clear description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce (if applicable)
- Potential impact
- Suggested remediation (if available)
- Your contact information

### Response Timeline

- **Initial acknowledgment**: Within 48 hours
- **Investigation**: We aim to investigate and respond within 7 days
- **Resolution**: Timeline depends on severity and complexity

### Security Advisories

Once a vulnerability is confirmed and fixed, we will:
1. Create a GitHub Security Advisory
2. Release a patched version
3. Notify all affected users through the advisory

### Supported Versions

This repository provides security guidance and checklists. Please refer to individual projects and tools for their specific security support policies.

## Security Best Practices for This Repository

- Keep your security checklists and policies up to date
- Review this repository regularly for updates
- Use this as a reference guide; consult official documentation for your specific tools and platforms
- Customize checklists to your organization's needs

## Additional Resources

- [GitHub Security Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security)
- [OWASP Top 10](https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/)
- [CIS Benchmarks](https://www.cisecurity.org/cis-benchmarks/)

Thank you for helping keep this resource and the broader security community safe.
